title: Sample toy
description: A two-file toy with one background source.

files.name: main.lua
files.source:
-- Sample toy: scrolls bg1 by the frame counter.
function frame(t, f)
  brightness = 15
  screen.main.bg1 = true
  bg[1].hofs = f
end

files.name: pokes.lua
files.source:
-- Helper pokes shared by the sample toy.
function poke_all(value)
  for i = 1, 4 do bg[i].vofs = value end
end
